name: Add FFT Plot Widget to OpenBCI GUI
description:
The OpenBCI GUI is running an active Synthetic EEG session with a multi-panel layout. Your task is to configure one of the widget panels to display the FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) Plot.

The FFT Plot widget shows the frequency spectrum of the EEG signal, with the x-axis representing frequency (in Hz) and the y-axis showing signal amplitude. Each channel is color-coded to match the Time Series display.

Steps:
1. Look at the widget panels — each panel has a dropdown selector at the top (or a title bar with the current widget name).
2. Find a panel that is currently NOT showing the FFT Plot (e.g., it shows 'Time Series', 'Empty', or another widget).
3. Click the dropdown selector for that panel.
4. From the dropdown menu, select 'FFT Plot' (it may also be labeled as 'FFT' or 'Spectrum').
5. The selected panel should now display the FFT frequency spectrum visualization.

After completing this task, at least one widget panel should display the FFT Plot showing the frequency spectrum of the synthetic EEG data.
